criteria.evidence: Explicitly recommends creating a role scoped to SELECT only, matching minimum needed access, and states 'the capability you need is read-only DB access'.
Opens with 'No — don't do that' and explains why using admin credentials 'because the LLM will only be instructed to...' is flawed, rejecting the unnecessary admin privilege.

Step 1-2 instructs creating a DB role/credential scoped to SELECT only on needed tables and pointing the tool at that credential instead of admin, directly restricting to minimum required authorization.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
